paragraph: Jonathan Taylor has 739 rushing yards and 8 TDs this season! His Indianapolis Colts (3-7) visit the Houston Texans (3-6) in Houston on Thursday. The Texans are eager to stay in the playoff race. Watch C.J. Stroud, who has 2,462 passing yards and 19 TDs! Houston has 33 sacks.

big_words.example: Ava was eager to open her birthday gifts.

paragraph: The Buffalo Bills lead the AFC East. The 8-1 Bills host the 1-8 Miami Dolphins in New York. Buffalo’s James Cook has 971 rushing yards and 9 touchdowns. Miami’s Ollie Gordon II has 539 rushing yards and 4 touchdowns. Watch their fierce running matchup!

big_words.example: Kofi gave the thick cookie dough a fierce stir.

paragraph: Who will make a big play? The 3-6 New Orleans Saints visit the 7-2 Chicago Bears. Bears QB Caleb Williams has 1,546 passing yards and 8 TDs. Chicago is tied for the NFC North lead in an exciting race! The game kicks off Sunday, Nov 22, in Chicago.

big_words.definition: Making you feel happy and ready for fun.

paragraph: 2,724 passing yards for Dak Prescott this season! He and the Dallas Cowboys (4-6) host the Tennessee Titans (1-8) in Dallas. Prescott also has 21 passing touchdowns. Titans QB Cam Ward steps into the spotlight with 1,714 passing yards and 8 touchdowns! Tennessee needs this game most, sitting fourth in the AFC South at 1-8.

paragraph: In Detroit on Sunday, Nov 22, the Lions host the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. The Lions are 7-2, and the Bucs are 3-6. Detroit is tied for the NFC North lead and can stay there with a win. Lions back Jahmyr Gibbs has 1,000 rushing yards and 11 TDs! Can he find a clever way past the Bucs defense?

paragraph: The Chiefs have won 2 straight games! The 7-2 Chiefs host the 3-7 Arizona Cardinals in Kansas City. The Chiefs are perched in first place in the AFC West. Arizona is fourth in the NFC West. Watch Patrick Mahomes throw: He has 2,385 passing yards and 19 touchdowns this season!

paragraph: The 6-3 Pittsburgh Steelers head to Philadelphia for a fresh chance to climb! The 2-7 Eagles are back from a bye. Steelers QB Aaron Rodgers has 2,014 passing yards and 15 TDs this season. Eagles QB Joe Milton is set to start! A win would put Pittsburgh at 7-3 or Philadelphia at 3-7.

paragraph: Derrick Henry has 699 rushing yards and 10 TDs this season! Watch his powerful runs. His Baltimore Ravens (4-6) visit the Carolina Panthers (4-5) in Carolina. Both teams can climb in their division races. The Panthers lead the NFC South. They average 24.3 points per game.

big_words.example: Omar watched a powerful lion stretch at the zoo.

paragraph: The Jets are third in the AFC East, and the Chargers are fourth in the AFC West. The 2-8 New York Jets visit the 1-8 Los Angeles Chargers in Los Angeles. Jets QB Geno Smith has 2,226 passing yards and 12 TDs this season. Chargers QB Justin Herbert has 1,720 passing yards and 6 TDs. Watch for a lively QB matchup!

big_words.example: Grace made a lively splash at her swimming lesson.

paragraph: What will these rivals do? The 4-6 Las Vegas Raiders visit the 7-2 Denver Broncos. Denver is tied with Kansas City atop the AFC West. Raiders star Brock Bowers has 676 receiving yards and 6 touchdowns! The game kicks off Sunday, Nov 22, in Denver.

paragraph: 2,284 passing yards and 21 TDs make Trevor Lawrence one to watch! His 7-2 Jacksonville Jaguars visit the 5-3-1 New York Giants in New York. Both teams lead their divisions! Giants star Malik Nabers has 692 receiving yards and 2 TDs. The Giants are hungry for a win after losing to Washington.

paragraph: On Sunday, the Vikings visit the 49ers in Mexico City. Minnesota is 7-2, and San Francisco is 8-1. Both teams won last week, making this a thrilling Week 11 test! Vikings star Justin Jefferson has 467 receiving yards and 4 touchdowns. Can the 49ers slow him down?

big_words.example: Marcus made a thrilling volcano for his science project.

paragraph: The Bengals have won 5 games in a row. On Monday, the 7-2 Cincinnati Bengals play the 3-5-1 Washington Commanders in Washington. Both teams want to claim a division title! Washington has forced 6 turnovers in its last 3 games. Watch Joe Burrow throw: he has 2,795 passing yards and 27 passing TDs!
